properties.biography: Henry Smithson, known professionally as Riton, began his career in the early 2000s in the UK electronic music scene. He quickly gained recognition for his unique blend of house and electronic dance music, incorporating elements of disco and funk. Over the years, Riton has collaborated with various artists and released multiple successful singles and remixes, establishing himself as a prominent figure in the electronic music community. His work is characterized by catchy beats, groovy basslines, and a strong emphasis on dancefloor appeal.

properties.biography: Alex Crossan, known professionally as Mura Masa, was born in Guernsey in 1996. He began making beats and producing on a laptop as a teenager and released early tracks on SoundCloud, which led to wider attention from blogs and listeners. Moving to the UK mainland to pursue music, he built a reputation for blending bright, detailed production with guest vocalists from different genres. He released his debut album in 2017 and has since worked with a range of artists while continuing to tour internationally and evolve his sound.
properties.known_for: Genre-blending electronic productions, meticulous beat design, melodic hooks and high-profile cross-genre collaborations.
properties.description: Mura Masa (Alex Crossan) is a British producer and songwriter from Guernsey whose work blends electronic production with pop, hip-hop and experimental textures. Rising from SoundCloud-era uploads to international acclaim, he is known for polished beat design, melodic hooks, and high-profile collaborations that span rap, pop and indie artists. His self-titled debut album and singles such as "Love$ick" brought him wide attention and regular festival and club bookings worldwide.
properties.cultural_impact: Helped popularize a polished, genre-blending style of electronic pop that connects underground production techniques with mainstream songwriting; known for bringing future-bass and leftfield electronic textures into pop and hip-hop collaborations, influencing a generation of young UK and international producers.
